part.text: All error-boundary suites pass. Final verification of the change:

Fixed. The issue was in `diff()`'s error-handling catch block (src/diff/index.js:265). When a list item's child component threw during a re-render, the vnode was handed to `_catchError` without its previous DOM/children pointers, so when the error boundary (the item itself via `useErrorBoundary`) re-rendered into a different return type, the old subtree DOM wasn't properly adopted/replaced and the item appeared both errored and normal.

The fix preserves `oldVNode._dom`/`_children` on `newVNode` in the non-hydrating bailout path (src/diff/index.js:274), so the boundary's diff can correctly replace the subtree.
